title: Carol Van Den Hende, Mars Inc's Global AI Responsibility Chair — 'This book is for any leader who's felt that purpose-driven businesses create more societal value and would like the data to back that'
summary: Van Den Hende chairs AI responsibility globally at Mars, sits on boards, and writes fiction on the side. Marking the Barnes & Noble selection, she names the audience precisely: leaders who already believe purpose-driven companies produce more societal value and want evidence rather than conviction. Her verdict on the argument is that it is clear, compelling and actionable. In a fuller Goodreads review the same day she adds a disclosure: she met Eric while preparing his talk for a leadership summit at her company.
blockquote: This book is for any leader who’s felt that purpose-driven businesses create more societal value and would like the data to back that. The thesis is clear, compelling, and actionable.
blockquote_source: Carol Van Den Hende on LinkedIn
